name: Tide Haze
description: Throw a haze heavy with tide water across a foe's sight so that it drips and blinds.

name: Wet Fog
description: Wrap the body in a fog so wet it runs like water over a blow.

name: Drizzle Step
description: Step on a falling sheet of rain made from the mist and land lightly a few paces away.

name: Fog Tide
description: Raise a grey tide out of the fog that rolls over every foe near the user.

name: Drenching Hold
description: Drench a foe in clinging vapor and water so that the foe's limbs grow heavy and slow.

name: Rain Cure
description: Let a soft rain fall on an ally and carry off a poison and a fever.

name: Tide Pall
description: Set a pall of fog and standing water on the ground that drags down any foe who steps in it.

name: Surge Mist
description: Loose a surge of mist and water in a tight jet at one foe.

name: Tidal Vanish
description: Vanish into the mist and surface from the tide behind the foe.

name: Drowning Fog
description: streams: Mist + Water. Join vapor and flood into a single grey tide that fills the lungs and sinks every foe in a wide ring.

name: Gale Haze
description: Whip a haze on a hard gust across a foe's face.

name: Fog Gust
description: Ride a gust of fog a long stride forward.

name: Haze Mantle
description: Wear a cloak of mist stirred by wind that turns blows and hides the body.

name: Fog Whirl
description: Spin the fog into a whirl that batters every foe within its turn.

name: Gust Hide
description: Hide a band of allies in a veil of gusting haze so that they cross open ground unseen.

name: Breeze Cure
description: Blow a cool breeze of haze through an ally and carry off a lingering taint.

name: Whirl Pull
description: Pull a foe off balance with a sudden whirl of fog round the legs.

name: Whirling Pall
description: Set a standing whirl of haze that spins any foe who nears it and spits them out.

name: Haze Cyclone
description: Wind the fog into a cyclone that flings foes in every direction.

name: Gale Phase
description: Ride a gale through barriers as mist rides through a net.

name: Obscuring Cyclone
description: streams: Mist + Wind. Weave haze and gale into a cyclone that blinds every foe and scatters them while the user passes unseen through its eye.
